text:
maya: Heads-up — starting onboarding for zeta-30b weights. Need to confirm source + tokenizer compat before we flip the model. S3 mirror exists but saw a checksum hiccup during last sync. Anyone free to help with artifact perms/verify?

kevin: I can check perms. Which path do you want us to verify, HF origin or the S3 mirror?

maya: Prefer the mirror for serving: s3://rwd-artifacts/models/zeta-30b/v1/weights.tar.lz4 and manifest at s3://rwd-artifacts/models/zeta-30b/v1/manifest.json. HF origin is huggingface.co/org/zeta-30b. Mirror job logged a digest mismatch on shard_0002.bin.

zafar: I saw that — manifest lists sha256 `5f2d9c7a...` but local compute shows `e3b0c44a...`. Likely truncated transfer. Did the mirror use multipart upload?

maya: No, it ran via the old sync job which does `aws s3 cp` from presigned URLs. Adding local check output: 
```
$ sha256sum shard_0002.bin
e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb924...  shard_0002.bin
(manifest expects) 5f2d9c7a...
```

kevin: can you paste the manifest line for that shard? Also run head-object to confirm size: `aws s3api head-object --bucket rwd-artifacts --key models/zeta-30b/v1/shard_0002.bin`

maya: manifest snippet: "shard_0002.bin": {"sha256": "5f2d9c7a9f1e...", "size": 2147483648}. Head-object shows size 2147483648, but my local file is 2097152000 — so local copy truncated.

lee: Presigned downloads can time out for >1GB objects. Our mirror job should use multipart download or the art-mirror tool which handles retries. Use: `art-mirror --multipart --retry 5`.

anna: Also flagging tokenizer: HF repo has `tokenizer.json` v0.10 while our runtime expects v0.12 layout. I hit emoji/unknown token differences in smoke tests. Might need a compatibility shim or prefer pulling HF tokenizer artifacts.

maya: Good point — if we prefer HF tokenizer artifact we can avoid format drift. For weights, I'll re-upload shard_0002 using multipart mirror.

deploy-bot: PR #987 — model-serving image build succeeded, but deploy blocked: `artifact-verify` job failed.

kevin: I'll re-run artifact-verify after shard re-upload. ETA ~45m. @maya can you re-upload with multipart and post new presigned link?

maya: Starting re-upload with `art-mirror --multipart`. Will post link when done.

maya: Done. New shard URL (presigned): https://s3.amazonaws.com/rwd-artifacts/models/zeta-30b/v1/shard_0002.bin?X...  Checksum now matches manifest `5f2d9c7a...`. Triggering artifact-verify.

zafar: Verified locally — `sha256sum` matches manifest. @deploy-bot can you requeue CI?

deploy-bot: Requeued job #987. Build -> staging. ETA ~12m. :rocket:

lee: Added a short docs note in infra-docs: use `art-mirror` for shards >1GB and prefer HF tokenizer artifacts when tokenizer schema mismatch detected.

maya: Thanks all — action items: kevin will monitor verify & CI, lee will update docs, anna will open tokenizer compatibility shim PR, and I’ll close once staging passes. :thumbsup:
